title: Subretinal fluid and vitreous proteomics in rhegmatogenous retinal detachment
summary: In this observational study we will collect samples of the subretinal fluid and the vitreous and analyze the protein composition. We aim at identifying biomarkers for a negative clinical outcome after surgery.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Cataract surgery done, retinal detachment, macular hole, gliosis
Exclusion criteria:
uveitis, glaucoma, diabetic retinopathy, intraocular tumor, active wet macular degeneration, retinal vein occlusion, systemic diseaes, PVR grade C or D
